business_summary: Liaoning He Eye Hospital Group Co., LTD., together with its subsidiaries, provides ophthalmological and optometry services to patients with eye diseases in China. The company offers treatment for common blinding eye diseases, including cataracts, glaucoma, and vitreoretinal disorders; specialized treatments, such as dry eye and traditional Chinese medicine; and optometry services, including optical correction, refractive surgery, and vision training for refractive errors. It also provides vitreoretinal diagnosis and treatment services, non-surgical and cataract treatment, and other eye disease diagnosis and treatment services; and cataract surgery, refractive error correction surgery, vitreoretinal surgery, and other surgical procedures. In addition, the company offers refractive cataracts, LASIK surgery, myopia prevention, medical fitting, diabetic retinopathy, dry eyes and cornea, gene diagnosis, and comprehensive eye disease solutions. Further, it engages in the sale and testing of medical devices; wholesale of optometry products; business and technical services; technology development, consulting, promotion, and application; import and export trade; wholesale business; and health and social work activities. Liaoning He Eye Hospital Group Co., LTD. was founded in 1995 and is based in Shenyang, China.
